scientific_integrity: The supplied stand-alone Python 3 checker enumerates the full 22-case permutation action, supplies a separate 315-isotropic-plane comparison and proves the five-count spectrum separation; no external independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Arithmetic classification of geometric reduced syzygetic tetrad finite etale schemes only. It does not classify all realizable branch cycles for a fixed small field or recover branch coordinates and does not give isogeny formulae. Underlying 315 tetrad construction, 105/210 split and S8 action were previously known (Bergvall 2016); priority risk remains for unindexed cycle-index literature.
title: Twenty-one Frobenius zeta spectra of genus-three syzygetic theta tetrads
